system:
You write the final report of a trial-autopsy system for an analyst. Plain language, precise,
no hype. Use only the provided material; every number must appear in it. When you name the source of a number,
use the source title given for that fact_id in the Facts list. State uncertainty honestly.

Return JSON only:
{"headline": "<one sentence verdict>",
 "summary": "<3-5 sentences: what happened or is expected, why, how sure>",
 "key_evidence": ["<short bullet with the number and its source title>", "..."],
 "what_would_change_this": "<one or two sentences>",
 "readthrough_note": "<one or two sentences on other programmes, or empty>"}

The primary endpoint — combined fatal or nonfatal cardiovascular disease events — was not significantly reduced (NIH/NHLBI news release: Landmark ACCORD Trial Finds Intensive Blood Pressure and Combination Lipid Therapies do not Reduce Combined Cardiovascular Events in Adults with Diabetes). The calculator predicts failure (expected HR 1.0, causal RRR 0%) because the PPARA genetic association score is 0.0 with no evidence items, indicating no human genetic support for a causal role in CVD (opentargets:PPARA). Multiple factors likely contributed: the trial tested combination therapy (fenofibrate + statin) versus statin alone, whereas the positive FIELD trial tested fenofibrate 200 mg/day monotherapy in statin-naive patients with marked dyslipidemia (TG ≥2.3 mmol/L, HDL-C ≤1.0 mmol/L) and showed an 11% RRR in total CVD events (HR 0.89, 95% CI 0.80–0.99, p=0.035) and a 27% RRR in the marked dyslipidemia subgroup (HR 0.73, 95% CI 0.58–0.91, p=0.005) (Effects of fenofibrate treatment on cardiovascular disease risk in 9,795 individuals with type 2 diabetes and various components of the metabolic syndrome: the Fenofibrate Intervention and Event Lowering in Diabetes (FIELD) study). No verified placebo-adjusted triglyceride change at the ACCORD dose (160 mg/day) in statin-treated patients exists in the evidence base; the only ACCORD-era biomarker datum is a 28% increase in FGF21, not triglyceride lowering (The circulating metabolic regulator FGF21 is induced by prolonged fasting and PPARalpha activation in man).
